cases.case_label: Founder SVA in 3' UTR of FKTN (FCMD)
cases.mechanism_detail: The ancestral SVA in the fukutin 3' UTR (exon 10) provides a strong splice acceptor that pairs with a rare alternative donor in exon 10, splicing out the 3' end of the coding region and proximal 3' UTR and adding SVA sequence; the protein loses its C-terminus and gains 129 SVA-encoded amino acids and mislocalizes. AONs against the SVA acceptor/ESE/ISE restored normal splicing and function.
cases.quote: Sequence analysis revealed an abnormal splicing event, provoked by a strong acceptor site in SVA and a rare alternative donor site in fukutin exon 10.

cases.case_label: SVA in LDLRAP1 (ARH) re-analysed for exon-trapping
cases.mechanism_detail: Previously reported disease-associated SVA insertion; RT-PCR of patient fibroblast cDNA showed splicing into the SVA (exon-trapping), as for FCMD.
cases.quote: Moreover, we observe exon-trapping in other SVA insertions associated with disease (hypercholesterolemia4, neutral lipid storage disease5) and human-specific SVA insertion in a novel gene.

cases.case_label: SVA in PNPLA2 (NLSDM) re-analysed for exon-trapping
cases.disease: Neutral lipid storage disease with myopathy
cases.mechanism_detail: Previously reported SVA insertion in PNPLA2; RT-PCR of patient fibroblast cDNA showed aberrant splicing into the SVA (exon-trapping).
cases.quote: Moreover, we observe exon-trapping in other SVA insertions associated with disease (hypercholesterolemia4, neutral lipid storage disease5) and human-specific SVA insertion in a novel gene.
